title: A Proof of Gluck's Conjecture
summary: For a finite group $H$, let $ν(H)$ denote the maximum order of a nilpotent subgroup of $H$. We prove that every finite solvable transitive permutation group $P$ on a finite set $Ω$ has a subset $Δ\subseteqΩ$ such that $|P:P_Δ|\geν(P_Δ)$. We also prove that if a finite solvable group $H$ acts faithfully and completely reducibly on a finite module $V$, then some $x\in V$ satisfies $|H:H_x|\geν(H_x)$.
